method:
Independent read-only current-tree review of every full file body in the exact 151-path assignment: all 128 non-test Web files and the first 23 assigned Web test files. Read the current AGENTS.md and honored the explicit two-clean-round user gate over its older three-round text. Before source review, verified all 1,901 inventory raw SHA-256 hashes and the canonical snapshot() result from scripts/snapshot.mjs using the pinned Node v24.22.1 runtime. File hashes, AST shape and test names were not used as substitutes for body review. Large outputs were divided or reread at omitted boundaries; all assigned bodies were completed.

Reviewed App/Workspace ownership and actual rendered parent keys, retained hidden panels, dialog lifetimes, authentication loss/recovery and connection/runtime generations before treating local component transitions as reachable. Traced event/history reconciliation, explicit resume, composer inputs and attachments, per-visit drafts, exact revision clearing, durable operation admission, accepted/unknown receipt recovery and non-replay, page/byte/count limits, escaping and explicit media loading, download and object-URL cleanup. Traced settings and authorization handoffs; project and environment selection; plugin, skill, MCP and remote-service configuration and consent; workspace edits, Git/index/worktree previews and revision binding; automation drafts, timezone previews and recovery; organization/import workflows; terminal/process and realtime media ownership, late completion and release paths; queue/goal/agent controls; Guardian authorization and history navigation. Checked entry/configuration files, CSS visibility, focus/responsive rules and documentation against the current source. Independently read all 23 assigned test bodies for their fixtures, mocked boundaries, claimed invariants and gaps; no assertions were treated as executed evidence.

Actual order and exposure: all 116 application/component/hook/library TS/TSX code files were fully reviewed before reading assigned web/VERIFICATION.md. That required current documentation file embeds historical implementation/audit outcome paragraphs, which were incidentally read during the remaining 12 entry/configuration/style/documentation files. No referenced audit report, prior finding report, Git history or old checkout was opened. Those embedded outcomes were not used to establish current correctness or findings. The assigned 23 test bodies were reviewed after this documentation read. Therefore this is independent current-source reasoning, not a claim of complete blindness to historical statements.

After the assigned bodies, cross-checked current backend workflow admission and result contracts: full src/core/feature-methods.ts, src/runtime/workflows.ts and src/runtime/guardian.ts, and relevant workflowMutation / configuration-admission excerpts in src/runtime/service.ts plus MCP and execution-setting receipt projections in src/gateway/receipt-result.ts. These supporting reads do not claim a complete backend audit. No candidate survived the actual parent-lifecycle, authorization and recovery checks as a confirmed actionable issue. No source edits, test execution, repro execution, remote calls or real credentials were used. Only ignored .work progress/integrity/report artifacts were written. Finally repeated all 1,901 raw hashes and canonical snapshot() and compared the exact assigned/reviewed path sets; all matched, with zero raw mismatches and zero unfinished assigned files.
limitations: Static full-body source and test review only. No browser rendering/accessibility run, live native CLI session, realtime microphone/media session, paid inference, external MCP/OAuth/remote service, real credential or deployment operation was exercised. No full or targeted tests were executed in this audit.

Assigned web/VERIFICATION.md contains embedded historical audit outcome statements. Exposure occurred after all 116 Web code files had been fully reviewed and before assigned test review; referenced earlier reports and old checkouts/history were not opened. Those statements were not used as evidence for the clean result.

This report completes only the exact 151 assigned Web paths. The other 46 Web test files and other repository scopes belong to separate reviewers; supporting backend contract reads are not a full backend coverage claim.
